name: ScrubGrid
tagline: The operations backbone for commercial cleaning crews
positioning: ScrubGrid gives owner-operators one place to schedule crews, run job checklists, log safety compliance, and invoice—without another spreadsheet.

hero.h1: Run every cleaning job like your best one
hero.sub: ScrubGrid turns your crew schedule, site checklists, safety logs, and invoices into one system your team can actually follow on their phones.

features.title: Crew scheduling that sticks
features.description: Assign crews to sites, set recurring routes, and text every tech their stops for the day—reshuffle in seconds when someone calls out sick.

features.title: Site checklists on the floor
features.description: Build room-by-room task lists per contract. Techs check off work with photos, so you prove the restrooms were done before the client calls.

features.title: Safety and SDS logs
features.description: Track chemical dilution ratios, equipment inspections, and OSHA-ready incident reports in one place instead of a binder in the van.

features.title: Invoice from the job
features.description: Turn completed work orders into invoices without re-keying anything. Bill per visit, per square foot, or monthly retainer.

features.title: Client site portal
features.description: Give property managers a login to see completed checklists, before-and-after photos, and their service history—fewer 'did you come?' emails.

features.title: Route-ready mobile app
features.description: Works offline in basements and stairwells, then syncs when the signal comes back. No lost job data at the end of a long shift.

testimonials.quote: We used to lose an hour every morning texting the crew their stops. Now they open ScrubGrid, see their route, and I get photo proof each site was cleaned before I'm even done with coffee.
testimonials.name: Marisol Vega

testimonials.quote: The safety log alone paid for it. When our warehouse client asked for chemical records during an audit, I exported everything in two minutes instead of digging through binders.
testimonials.name: Dwayne Ferris

testimonials.quote: Invoicing straight from completed work orders cut our billing week down to an afternoon. My techs actually finish their checklists now because it's faster than the old paper sheets.
testimonials.name: Priya Nandakumar

homepage.footerBlurb: ScrubGrid is the operations platform built for commercial cleaning owner-operators—schedule, prove, and bill the work from one place.
